description: Number to words (and back) — Spell numbers in English: words, ordinal (twenty-first, 21st), Roman numerals (1-3999), currency words and check-writing format (One thousand two hundred thirty-four and 56/100 dollars) for USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, INR, JPY, MXN, CHF. Exact up to 10^18 (BigInt). Or text= to parse English words back to a number (two thousand and five, one hundred twenty-first, 1.5 million, three point one four). Params: n= or text=, optional currency=. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_number_words
